name: Generate FAQ content
description: NORMALIZE_NOW — AI FAQ text/JSON only. Domain persist stays in caller/Business Action.

template.system: Return FAQ as a JSON object with key faqs (array of {question, answer}). Language: {{language}}. No markdown fences.

presentation.description: Generate frequently asked questions from the article content.
default_instructions: Questions must relate directly to the article content.
Answers should be short and useful.
Do not add facts that are not present in the source.
Avoid duplicate questions that cover the same idea.
output_format: Readable shape per item: Question / Answer.
No markdown fences and no free-form essay outside the JSON object.
notes: Domain persistence (saving FAQ to the article) stays in the caller — this Hook only generates content.
